# Buy Me a Book

> A community helping readers across Africa and beyond access books. Request a Kindle book you cannot afford, help another reader, or explore free reading resources.

## Main journeys

- Request a book: https://www.buymebook.com/buy-me-a-book.html#request
- Give a book: https://www.buymebook.com/buy-me-a-book.html#browse
- Read for free: https://www.buymebook.com/buy-me-a-book.html#free
- How it works: https://www.buymebook.com/buy-me-a-book.html#how

Readers submit a title, author, Amazon Kindle link, short reason, name, and email. Requests are moderated before publication. Submitting a request is free and does not guarantee a gift. The success screen provides a confirmation code to save.

Donors choose a request, review its details, and use Amazon’s Kindle gifting flow. Purchases happen on Amazon. After purchase, donors return to mark the request as gifted; recipients confirm receipt after redeeming their book.

## Availability and privacy

Amazon only allows Kindle gifts to be redeemed by recipients in the same country as the giver. This site does not verify country eligibility. Donors should confirm it with recipients before paying. Do not describe Kindle gifts as available worldwide or promise automatic gift-card conversion.

Amazon’s rules: https://www.amazon.com/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GVWGP284MQ6ZRM59

Approved requests display the reader’s name, book, and reason. Donors can access the recipient email to send a gift. Payments and payment details stay on Amazon. Readers should not include private addresses or phone numbers in their request.

## Free reading

The main free-reading page highlights OpenStax textbooks, Project Gutenberg classics, BookSmart by Worldreader for children, and LibriVox audiobooks. Additional libraries and paid Kindle options are separated into expandable sections. Availability and copyright rules vary by country.

## More pages

The More menu includes receipt confirmation, how it works, gifted books, all requests, recommendations, curated reading lists, book reviews, and about the project. Requests and reviews are moderated. Sample records are excluded from public request lists and counts. Offline cached requests are explicitly labeled.

## Project

Founder: Samuel Kimani Sikuku — https://github.com/SamuelKimaniSikuku
Source: https://github.com/SamuelKimaniSikuku/buymebook
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/136074509/

The platform charges no fee for requests or gifts. Some outgoing Amazon links carry the affiliate tag samuelkimanis-20 and may earn a commission on qualifying purchases, at no extra cost to the purchaser.
